## MarkdownFeature.withConfig() method

The [MarkdownFeature.withConfig()](./api-documenter.markdownfeature.withconfig.md) method creates a concrete `MarkdownDocumenterFeature` subclass bound to the specified `featureConfig`<!-- -->.

**Signature:**

```typescript
static withConfig(featureConfig: MarkdownFeatureConfig): MarkdownFeatureConstructor;
```

**Returns:**

## Example


```ts
import { MarkdownFeature } from "@positron/api-documenter";

export default MarkdownFeature.withConfig({
  onBeforeWritePage: ({ content }) => {
    // do something with page

    return content;
  },
});
```
